topic: A cinematic milk-and-cookies table scene that ends with a hand placing a glass of milk beside the plate
prompt_goal: Create one Veo 3.1 compatible prompt that uses a specific opening frame and ending frame to shape a clean visual transition.
project_title: Veo First and Last Frame Demo
main_subject: A rustic plate of cookies on a warmly lit tabletop.
setting: A cozy kitchen tabletop scene with soft morning light, warm wood grain, and subtle domestic realism.
action: The clip starts on the plate of cookies, then a hand enters naturally and places a glass of milk beside the plate to complete the final frame.
blocking_and_staging: Keep the cookies anchored in place while the hand enters from off-frame and lands the milk glass cleanly beside them.
foreground_midground_background: Foreground table texture, cookies in the midground, and soft kitchen blur in the background.
must_include: clean table action, realistic hand placement, cozy food-commercial realism
avoid: warped fingers, jittery object motion, cluttered set dressing
